prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Synthesize Your Custom Companion", "Upload photos and tweak core visual traits to generate your perfect desktop companion.", "Select Trait Mix"]
1: ["Practice Desktop Pet Controls", "Try dragging, calling, and hiding your companion in this practice sandbox before placing it on your real desktop.", "Launch to Real Desktop"]
2: ["Secure Your Pet Save File", "Link your account now to guarantee cloud save persistence so your companion is never lost or reset.", "Your companion progress syncs automatically with encrypted cloud backups.", "Cloud Save Verification Active"]
3: []
4: ["Preparing Desktop Companion Overlay", "Checking system display transparency and companion animation renderer.", "Desktop Overlay Supported"]
5: ["Best results: Use evenly lit front-facing photos without strong shadows or filters.", "Photo Recommendations"]
6: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Here is your essential companion control guide for hotkeys, tray toggles, and chat controls.", "Hotkey & Tray Shortcuts"]
7: ["Link Account to Protect Companion Progress", "Create or sign into your account to back up your companion's memory, items, and traits safely to the cloud.", "Secure Companion Save File"]
8: ["Find Your Companion Match", "Answer two quick questions so we can suggest the best setup path for your desktop setup.", "How quickly do you want your pet on your desktop?"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "You have unlocked the Founder Companion Badge! Name your pet to complete the adoption certificate.", "Founder Companion Badge Unlocked", "Companion Name"]
